title: hoa_fined_me_for_the_tree
display_title: The HOA fined me $40 a day for a tree I never planted
beats: My HOA fined me $40 a day for a tree that isn't even mine.
It's on the property line, but the deed says it's my neighbor's tree, not mine — I checked twice.
I told the board, showed them the survey, and they said 'take it up with him' while the fine kept running.
So I did nothing, let it hit $2,400, and mailed the invoice straight to my neighbor's house instead.
He paid it in four days flat rather than let anyone find out why the tree was really planted there.
Was I wrong for staying quiet?
